source_findings.five_dollar_football_api: blocked: verified Libertadores coverage (league id 3899038422, data-quality page) with explicitly defined opening/closing semantics for bet365 tick history, but historical queries and odds/history are Ultra-plan only; Free is top-5 leagues only, Pro is last 12 months only. No key was used and nothing was paid, so 0 rows were retrieved. Season labels on this source (e.g. 2025/26) do NOT correspond to Libertadores calendar-year editions and must be sliced by actual date windows, never by ?season=.
source_findings.football_data_co_uk: unavailable: the site data index lists only domestic leagues (Brazil Serie A, Argentina Primera Division) and contains zero hits for Libertadores/CONMEBOL; there is no Libertadores coverage to fetch. Its terms also restrict use against automated scraping/AI data products, so no CSV was downloaded.
